title: Concatenation machine run
statement: For any Boolean words $x$ and $s$, running the assembly machine on input $x$ from its initial configuration with $s$ on its work tape for $|x|+|s|+2$ steps gives a halted configuration. Its input head is at the right boundary blank, its work tape stores $s$ with the head at position $|s|$, and its output is $x$ followed by $s$.
replaced:
For all binary words $x$ and $s$, the assembly machine started in its input phase
on input $x$, with $s$ on its work tape and all heads at their starting positions,
is halted after exactly $|x| + |s| + 2$ steps with output $x \mathbin{+\!\!+} s$,
its input head at the right boundary, the candidate tape unchanged, and the
candidate head at position $|s|$.
